F11 supplementary observer preparation. No actual F11 rendering has been performed here. Parent source/control review is required before the prepared uniform observation command is used.

The frozen observer attempts to click an email input inside a closed dialog. This derivative keeps the original HTTP transport byte-identical, including immutable snapshot copies, disjoint outputs, path/method restrictions, deny proxy, interception and exact existing browser/Puppeteer runtime. It preserves the original wide/narrow measurements, tab trace and reduced-motion observations.

The additional interaction pass runs at both widths. It reaches the visible dialog opener with Tab and activates it with Enter, records modal focus, tests Escape/focus return, reopens with the keyboard and reaches the actual form submit control. Inline forms use the same invalid/valid submission checks. It types through keyboard events and records exact event/status before and after submissions. No showModal, requestSubmit, forced focus or click fallback is used by the observer. Missing, inaccessible or broken controls remain explicit failed observations. No quality grades are assigned.

A native Chromium Tab cycle can expose BODY while keyboard focus passes through browser chrome. Raw focus sequences, documentHasFocus and outside-control observations are retained; BODY alone is not interpreted as an escaped modal focus trap. The maximum search is 48 Tab presses per target. Undetected late asynchronous behavior remains a limitation; observations settle through two animation frames.

Preparation controls use newly authored synthetic inline/dialog/broken/inaccessible pages, not F11 outputs. Seven controls passed, including real browser network confinement, immutable bytes and launch-failure evidence. Initial Control+A shortcut misuse failed three controls; `initial-control-failure.json` preserves that observer defect and its correction to native keydown/press/keyup.

Commands:

- Verify frozen preparation and all six opaque artifact bindings: `node tests/fixtures/frontend-adoption-v3-f11-http/observe-all.mjs verify`
- Re-run isolated controls: `node --test tests/fixtures/frontend-adoption-v3-f11-http/observer.test.mjs`
- Parent only, after review: `node tests/fixtures/frontend-adoption-v3-f11-http/observe-all.mjs observe /absolute/fresh/supplement-output`

The launcher preflights all six bound F11 inputs, observes each once, retains any failure and writes append-only incremental inventories. It does not edit or replace the original observations, artifacts, scores or native events. Browser sandbox opt-out remains the original process-local trusted fixture setting; no host/Codex settings change occurs. Failed browser launches have no automatic fallback. Network attempts are retained separately from completed requests.
